question: Should OpenClaw adopt AG-UI as a bundled, core-packaged channel with an authenticated HTTP/SSE gateway surface?
rationale: This PR adds a user-facing channel, configuration metadata, package distribution behavior, and an inbound authentication boundary; the repository policy reserves this product and ownership choice for maintainers.

options.title: Sponsor bundled AG-UI
options.body: Approve the bundled-channel direction, then require exact-head dependency authorization and fresh packaged-install proof before continuing merge review.

options.title: Require an external package path
options.body: Decline bundling and request an externally maintained plugin/package if maintainers want AG-UI available without expanding the bundled core channel set.

options.title: Defer channel direction
options.body: Keep the PR open while channel and security owners decide whether a general external-channel distribution model is needed first.

recommendation.title: Sponsor bundled AG-UI
recommendation.body: Approve the bundled-channel direction, then require exact-head dependency authorization and fresh packaged-install proof before continuing merge review.

likelyOwner.reason: mme is the closest routing candidate in the supplied history for the current bundled-channel lifecycle integration.
